reviews.text: We could not have had a better introduction to Vietnam. The owners and team at The Night Market Villa were without a doubt the most friendly and genuinely kind people we have met on our entire trip through the region. We are very pleased to have met them. Every day for breakfast, they greeted us with warm smiles, cooked delicious hot food, and insisted on us taking seconds and thirds even if it meant a whole new round of cooking, but as breakfast is in a family style kitchen, it’s a social event - they pamper their guests as a grandma does her grandchildren. All this despite recent events. A few days before our arrival, Hoi An had experienced some rather horrendous flooding after a terrible typhoon, and yet we were still met with smiles and made to feel totally at home while they were cleaning up the aftermath. It was very humbling to see the community coming together and the persevering positivity. Thank you for having us. We will be back 😊

reviews.text:
Thought I had died and gone to sports bar heaven!

This is by far the best place to catch a game in Hoi An. Big screen tvs upstairs and down, beers starting at 35VND and authentic jerk chicken cooked on a downstairs barbecue, what more can you ask for?

Great atmosphere in the upstairs man cave, we watched a few of the world cup games up here on our recent trip to Hoi An, nice mix of ex pats, locals and holidaymakers like myself. The man cave is run by the English barman Kevin who we found to be friendly and happy to share his insider tips of where to visit locally.

Route 66 is more than just a sports bar though, nice chill out vibe downstairs, if its not laid back reggae/r and b playing its one of the cool local acts that plays is booked here on a Friday-Sunday.

The owners Chim and Lun are great hosts and also happy to share their insider tips of where best to eat and drink at other cool bars like Route 66.

We will be back next time we visit Hoi An 👍🏻

reviews.text:
A lovely place to spend an evening in Hoi An! The night market is full of colorful lanterns, handmade souvenirs, local snacks, and a lively atmosphere. Walking along the riverside while enjoying the beautiful lights makes the experience even more special.

The market is easy to explore, and there are plenty of great photo spots. Prices vary from stall to stall, so it’s worth taking a look around before buying. Overall, it’s a must-visit destination if you’re in Hoi An and want to experience the city’s vibrant nightlife and local culture. Highly recommended!

Popular with native locals and ex-pat locals alike. Super chilled vibe. We spent hours hanging out and would totally make it out regular local if we were here longer.

If you’re in the area, I highly recommend you visit Bungalow Beach Bar.

Here’s a natural, personal review you can post:

Bungalow Beach Bar is the perfect place to relax and unwind after exploring Hoi An. Located just steps from the beach, it has a laid-back, tropical vibe that’s ideal for spending a lazy afternoon or watching the sunset.

What I really loved was the combination of a swimming pool, a pool table, comfortable seating, and a chilled-out atmosphere. Whether you want to enjoy a drink, take a dip in the pool, or simply hang out with friends, this place has it all.

The staff were welcoming, the ambiance was relaxed, and it felt like one of those hidden gems where time slows down. If you’re around An Bang Beach and looking for a place to kick back, Bungalow Beach Bar is definitely worth a visit.

We've visited An Bang Beach 3 times in the past 2 years and THIS is the place to be. The best bar with the best staff who are friendly and remember your order, even after it's been months since we visited. Huge selection of craft beers on tap, wines, happy hour, a swimming pool and pool table in excellent condition. There's live music, open mic nights, pool comps, karaoke. Food serviced from the Lighthouse restaurant next door is amazing too. A chilled bar with a great vibe, and great community of regulars. This bar is the reason we keep returning to An Bang and we will be back again.

We came here many times during our 4 day stay. Great choice of craft beers at reasonable prices, amazingly friendly and fun staff. Pool competition on Wednesday's and an open mic on Thursday's. Highly recommended.

title: Mezcal Cocteleria [Cocktail Bar]
ownerDescription:
Mezcal Coctelería is Vietnam’s first agave spirits cocktail bar, showcasing premium mezcals and tequilas through both traditional serves and innovative cocktails. Set beneath antique brick arches and candlelight, the bar combines Mexican spirit culture with a refined, atmospheric setting in the heart of Hội An.

Alongside its agave-focused cocktail menu, Mezcal features an A Bit Odd Coravin wine list, offering a carefully selected range of wines by the glass. Passionate bartenders bring knowledge and creativity to every serve, while the space sets the mood for date nights, intimate evenings, and occasional music nights. Sophisticated, distinctive, and unapologetically agave-focused, Mezcal offers a different side of cocktail culture.

ownerUpdates.text:
A trip through Latin America (and beyond) that would leave a carbon footprint big enough to decimate an entire mangrove swamp. A concoction of tropical cumbias, rancheras, valses, and folk music from places as distant and warm as Colombia, Venezuela, Mexico, Argentina, Paraguay, Brazil, and Cuba.
Some tunes work like a snake charmer for the hips, others are contagiously whiny, most are cocktail-inducing, and a few special ones manage to do it all at once.
Pocalipse, a staple at Mezcal and an enthusiastic adopter of sounds from a place three continents removed, will also bring in some of his own repertoire, complete with face-melting vocals and piano.
The incredible vocalist, Ana, will accompany with captivating sounds from her latin background...and shaking various objects.

ownerUpdates.text:
🍔 OUR TOP BESTSELLER: THE SAIME HOUSE BEEF BURGER

While our kitchen is deeply rooted in Vietnamese flavors, our chefs bring the exact same obsessive care and experimentation to our Western comfort classics!

To create the ultimate juiciest burger, our beef patties are seasoned with finely chopped onions, onion powder, and breadcrumbs to lock in every drop of moisture. We pan-sear the patty, oven-bake it with a touch of real butter for rich tenderness, and give it a final pan-sear for that smoky, caramelized outer crust.

Layered with crispy grilled bacon, a sunny-side-up egg capped with melted cheese, and our signature trio burger sauce (mayo, ketchup, mustard), it’s a flavor explosion in every bite!

🗓️ Open daily from 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Closed Mondays).
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🍅 A REFRESHING TWIST: CLARIFIED BLOODY MARY

Think Bloody Mary is too heavy or intense? Our Modern Cocktail version will completely change your mind!

We take this famous savory cocktail and refine it using milk clarification to create a crystal-clear, surprisingly smooth drink. We combine juicy tomato with charred bell pepper, a vibrant kick of Tabasco, and fragrant roasted black pepper. The result is light, crisp, subtly spicy, and incredibly easy to enjoy.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🌾 THE ULTIMATE STREET SNACK: CRUNCHY SAIGON RICE CRACKERS

Inspired by the bustling street corners of Saigon, our Cơm Cháy brings authentic local flavors straight to your table. We fry golden rice crackers until super crispy, then brush them with house pate, fragrant scallion oil, and a sweet-and-savory fish sauce reduction.

The final touch? A generous layer of our house-made Taiwanese-style pork floss infused with a hint of cinnamon. It’s crunchy, savory, sweet, and unbelievably addictive!

🗓️ Open daily from 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Closed Mondays).
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🥥 CLASSIC REIMAGINED: CLARIFIED PIÑA COLADA

Beside our signature cocktails, Saime invites you to explore our Modern Cocktail series - fresh, creative takes on world classics!

Through a precise milk-clarification technique, we elevate the iconic Piña Colada into a silky, crystal-clear drink. It retains all the creamy coconut fragrance and vibrant sweet-and-sour pineapple notes, but with a lighter, smoother texture that makes it effortlessly refreshing to sip.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🌽 A NEW TWIST ON STREET FOOD: CORN WONTONS

When designing our snack menu, our founder remembered her favorite schoolyard treat: sautéed corn (bắp xào). Instead of traditional spring rolls, we experimented with wrapping sweet sautéed corn and scallions inside delicate wonton skins, fried to a gorgeous golden crunch.

Today, it’s our

🍉 SUMMER REFRESHMENT: THE RUBY SPLASH COCKTAIL

Created directly from requests by our lovely female guests looking for a fresh, fruit-forward cocktail, the Ruby Splash is pure sunshine in a glass!

We shake premium Gin and Triple Sec with freshly pressed watermelon juice, a splash of zesty lime, and fragrant garden spearmint leaves (húng lủi). It’s vibrant, naturally sweet, deeply hydrating, and effortlessly easy to sip.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🍚 CHILDHOOD MEMORIES: SAIGON STICKY RICE

For generations of Vietnamese students, a warm box of Xôi Mặn was the ultimate morning fuel before class. We wanted to recreate this nostalgic Saigon staple in a cozy, modern space, where you can slow down and savor every bite without rushing off to school or work.

Every plate features fluffy glutinous rice layered with our creamy house-made pate, aromatic scallion oil, sweet-and-savory caramelized radish with dried shrimp, and house-made cinnamon pork floss. We top it off with Chinese-style char siu pork, fresh cilantro, and house pickles.

🗓️ Open daily from 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Closed Mondays).
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

💋 SWEET STREET NOSTALGIA: THE BLOW KISS COCKTAIL

Inspired by two quintessential Vietnamese street drinks: salted plum kumquat tea (trà tắc xí muội) and fresh strawberry tea (trà dâu), our bartenders crafted a drink as sweet and memorable as a blow kiss!

We layer our house-made strawberry cordial with tangy, savory salted kumquat jam, then shake it over vodka and Vietnamese black tea. The result is a gorgeous ruby-red cocktail with a delicate fruity sweetness, a hint of salt, and a subtle tea tannin finish.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

TRADITION REIMAGINED: LUNAR NEW YEAR IN A BITE

In Vietnamese homes, Thịt Kho Măng (braised pork with bamboo shoots) is the ultimate Tết comfort dish, traditionally shared over steaming bowls of white rice. At Saime, we wanted to share this cherished memory with our guests in a fresh, bite-sized way.

After many kitchen trials, we found the perfect match: soft, pillow-steamed mantou buns stuffed with tender, melt-in-your-mouth braised pork belly and crunchy bamboo shoots. It’s savory, rich, and full of nostalgic warmth.

📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An
Open from 3pm to 11pm

🥃 VIETNAM’S ICON REIMAGINED: THE PHỞ COCKTAIL

Pho is a symbol of Vietnamese culinary heritage, and our mixologists set out to translate those deep, soul-warming spices into a craft cocktail.

We simmer a rich Pho reduction infused with black cardamom, cinnamon, star anise, and dried bay leaves. Shaken with Gin, Triple Sec, and fresh saw-tooth coriander (ngò gai), it delivers the unmistakable, aromatic essence of authentic Pho.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!

reviews.text: Beautiful place with a lovely view! ❤️ The staff were friendly and the service was great.  It is very comfortable place to rest and wait for the sunset 🌅The location is also very convenient, just a short walk from the boat pier where you can enjoy the lantern boat rides. A perfect spot to relax, enjoy a nice coffee, and soak in the charm of Hội An. Highly recommended! ☕🏮✨

What a wonderful place for a drink! Dat was awesomely welcoming, made us super cute but most importantly very tasty drinks. The salted coffee was the best I’ve had in Vietnam, and had a beautiful design on it. Not as crowded with Instagrammers as Faifo, and it made it a lot more enjoyable. We had the balcony to ourselves, and the scent of honeysuckle while we sipped on our drinks while people watching in the street below just made the experience absolutely perfect! I highly recommend it!

We tried the salted coffee and coconut coffee, and both were amazing! The flavors were rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced. What impressed us even more was the presentation, the drinks looked so beautiful that we almost felt guilty taking the first sip and disturbing the lovely design on top.

The attendant was incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. Delicious coffee, wonderful service, and attention to detail that truly stands out. Highly recommended!

If you're visiting Hoi An, make sure to stop by and try their coffee. You won't regret it! ☕✨🥥

We came here late in the evening for a coffee, such a cozy place and excellent coffee. They have a great rooftop terrace which overlooks the old town, perfect scenery and a nice spot to get your caffeine fix while enjoying the great views! ☕✨

Traveled to Hoi An and was craving a classic Vietnamese egg coffee! ☕️ I checked Google for the best spots and found this gem just a 10-minute walk away from my location. The staff were super welcoming, and the egg coffee was absolutely amazing, beautiful design too- the perfect cool down from the Hoi An heat! ☀️🇻🇳

Dat was our waiter and he was great with excellent service and conversation! We were recommended by our hotel to go here while in Hoi An so we went for a coffee at sunset and then decided to have two cocktails afterwards. The photos speak for themselves if you want a nice, relaxing atmosphere to wait to do the lanterns. Also the playlist was excellent.

ownerUpdates.text: Well come to the BEACH REGGAE BAR AND RESTAURANT an bang beach

reviews.text: Great new beach bar! Chill vibes, pho was 🤤 and cold beer! What more could you ask for 🤷‍♂️ 5 stars ⭐️

Service:
- The young guy who greeted me was very welcoming and friendly.
- I was the only customer, but it still took 20 mins for my Pina Colada to be delivered.
- When it’s busy, the wait time may be challenging.
- Rating: 4/5

Atmosphere:
- For the first 25 mins there was no music. They then played numerous Westlife songs 🤔 Not what I’m used to in a reggae bar.
- To keep you cool they have numerous portable fans.
- Seating: A mixture of high-back wooden chairs with no cushions and low-back wooden bar stools.
- They also have a pool table.
- Rating: 3/5

Dear Owner,
I’d suggest adding some cushions, as if your customers aren’t comfortable, they won’t stay long.

My Order:
- 1 x Pina Colada
- Unfortunately, it wasn’t to my taste, so I paid and left it.
- Price: 160K (Expensive compared to other bars!)
- Rating: 2/5

Important Information:
- Happy Hour: 13:00 to 18:30
- During Happy Hour, the buy one get one free is only applicable if you order the same cocktail 😔

Additional Information:
- I would also say their beer prices are definitely on the higher side.
- LARUE, Saigon and Huda: 45K (330ml)
- 333: 55K(330ml)
- Tiger: 55K (330ml)
- Saigon: 55K (550ml)

* Overall Rating: 3/5
Best bar on an bang beach! The owner is so kind and welcoming and there is a good happy hour! We will definitely be back
The Beach Reggae bar has the best music, vibe and most of all their cocktails are absolutely delicious. Try their mojito it’s flavorful with fresh herbs. This is my spot while in Hoi An, Vietnam.

Love from Lorrha, Tipperary, Ireland.

title: Karaoke Avatar Hội An

Hệ thống âm thanh Bose, JBL kết hợp kho nhạc phong phú từ nhạc trẻ, bolero đến quốc tế mang đến trải nghiệm giải trí đỉnh cao. Dịch vụ chuyên nghiệp, giá cả hợp lý, có hỗ trợ trang trí sự kiện theo yêu cầu.
👉 Đặt phòng ngay để tận hưởng những phút giây ca hát sôi động tại Karaoke Avatar Hội An!

questionsAndAnswers.question:
(Translated by Google) How much does it cost to sing here per hour?

(Original)
Hát ở đây bao nhiêu tiền 1 tiếng vậy ạ?

answers.answer:
Dạ giá 300k/giờ hát ạ.
Những phòng lớn cho đoàn từ 20 khách trở lên sẽ có giá 500-600k/giờ ạ.

reviews.text: We wanted to do some karaoke to end the night, but the staff out front said big groups only. I think this is stupid, I am willing to pay the same price but he just kept saying “big group only”. It didn’t seem busy so I don’t see why there is a problem.

Once we got started, it was super easy and fun. But when we were in our room the mics didn't have batteries for the first 10min. But their drinks section was great. We were there for 2 hours and cost about 900k.
Literally the funniest place ever - I won’t elaborate further
We were 4 Aussie’s looking for some fun, and boy did we have it!!!!!!  Thank you Avatar Karaoke venue and staff are excellent
Decent bad sound system tho pricy
Great karaoke joint and a lovely walk back to A Bang!

reviews.text: Just ask at reception and they will show you to the lift.  It is set up nice on the roof, although perhaps a couple of the murals could be changed to something more appropriate.  a couple of drinks and some nibbles whilst watching the sun going down isn't a bad way to while away an hour or so

Special thanks to the super friendly and funny barman Alan. He deserves 5+ stars. He made us very nice cocktails, gave us good recommendations in Hoi An and was extremely friendly. Excellent service. Do not hesitate to come. And the view is really nice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Vanessa Englebert,

Welcome to Deli Sky Bar & Coffee Lounge, the superb rooftop destination within the hotel where you enjoyed four delightful nights. We're thrilled to hear about your fantastic experience, and we extend our gratitude for your kind words, especially for our outstanding bartender, Alan.

At Deli Sky Bar, we take pride in offering not only some of the best cocktails in Hoi An but also an unforgettable atmosphere where every moment is cherished. Alan's dedication to providing exceptional service and creating memorable experiences is truly commendable, and we're delighted that he exceeded your expectations.

As you mentioned, our rooftop not only offers stunning views but also provides a warm and inviting ambiance that makes every visit special. We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed both the drinks and the atmosphere during your stay.

We invite you to return to Deli Sky Bar Hoi An whenever you're in town, where you can expect nothing less than excellent service, superb cocktails, and unforgettable memories.

Best regards,
Deli Sky Bar Hoi An
